description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- 4-passenger golf cart- 5 adult bikes- Professionally decorated- Fenced-in yard - High-end appliances- Located next to Puttering Park- Access to neighborhood pool and fitness center (additional fees apply) - Flat-screen TVs in every bedroom- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private Deeded Beach Access- Free WiFi- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout *This property comes with 3 designated parking spaces. This home permits a maximum of 3 vehicles through the community security gate.DETAILS: Light, bright and airy paradise! Plenty of natural light shines through this professionally designed 5-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom home meant to sleep 12 guests. Coastal, white decor and oversized windows throughout create serenity throughout the house. Guests staying at 19 W. Saltbox Lane will have access to WaterSound's neighborhood pool and gym. It's also located next to the Puttering Park, where golfers can putt on the green area before playing a round on one of their championship golf courses. An open-concept kitchen, dining, and living room introduce guests to the home as they walk through the front door. It has access to the back porch with forest views and an outdoor seating area overlooking the backyard allowing for plenty of privacy. The gourmet kitchen features premium, stainless-steel appliances, a farmhouse sink and seating for 12 at the breakfast bar and dining table. The living room includes a fireplace and large flat-screen TV. A powder room and the first guest room are down the hall. A king bed, private bathroom and access to the porch are included in the first bedroom. The primary suite is upstairs and features French doors opening up to a private balcony with a shaded seating area and private bathroom with a luxurious soaking tub. Adjacent is another king bedroom with a private balcony and private bathroom. The laundry room is on this floor as well. The third floor belongs to the kids! With 4-single beds and a large media console, this open-floor plan has plenty of seating space and a wet bar to entertain guests. There is also a private bathroom with a shower only. The carriage house is accessible from the backyard and features additional accommodation for guests with a plush king-sized bedroom, private bathroom and kitchenette. Guests can take a short bike or golf cart ride to the private beach and along the nature trails. Don't miss your chance to stay at this beautiful home with your family!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 12):FIRST FLOOR:Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and TubGuest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboHallway Bathroom: Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:Loft Area: Four Twin Single BedsCARRIAGE HOUSE:Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
